commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+7' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) works the corner short.
90+6' Luton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+4' Darren England shows a yellow card to Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
90+2' The Newcastle players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Teden Mengi (Luton) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
86' Ross Barkley (Luton) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
85' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Dan Burn and he is replaced by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).
84' The attendance is 11042.
81' Substitution. Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) in, Miguel Almiron out.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andros Townsend leaves the pitch and Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) comes on.
80' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlton Morris (Luton) replacing Elijah Adebayo.
80' Substitution. Albert Sambi Lokonga makes way for Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton).
80' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
79' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Newcastle force their opponents to concede a corner.
79' A pass from Ryan Giles (Luton) is intercepted by Martin Dubravka and the move breaks down.
78' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
78' The ball is cleared after Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Newcastle have a corner.
77' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd), but it's just wide of the right post.
76' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is about to take a corner kick.
76' Mads Juel Andersen (Luton) comes onto the pitch because Amari'i Bell simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
76' Amari'i Bell (Luton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
74' Alfie Doughty (Luton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
72' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Darren England stops the game and makes a call.
71' Newcastle failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' The resulting corner from Alfie Doughty (Luton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
63' The Newcastle players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Darren England signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
62' Attention! Referee Darren England straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
61' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) has a goal ruled out for offside!
59' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Darren England blows for a foul.
56' Ross Barkley (Luton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
54' A big opportunity missed by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd). He got on the ball inside the box and thumped a splendid first-time shot on goal, but it went narrowly wide of the right post.
52' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes a short corner kick.
49' Ryan Giles (Luton) makes a strong challenge and Darren England blows for a foul.
46' It will be a substitution. Ryan Giles (Luton) is ready to enter the pitch as Issa Kabore walks off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Newcastle are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Rough tackle by Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

42' Andros Townsend (Luton) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Martin Dubravka pulls off an easy save.
40' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) makes a good run to latch onto the free kick from Kieran Trippier, but pushes his close-range header well past the left post.
39' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) makes a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Lewis Miley will be replaced by Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd).
37' Eddie Howe is forced to make a change. Jamaal Lascelles is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd).
36' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) picks up an injury.

35' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Martin Dubravka anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
34' That was absolutely fantastic! Ross Barkley (Luton) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
33' Issa Kabore (Luton) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
32' Gabriel Osho (Luton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Darren England saw the whole situation.
30' Darren England blows his whistle. Andros Townsend (Luton) commits a foul after dangerous play.
29' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
29' Darren England interrupts the game. One of the players from Luton won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
25' 1 - 0 GOAL! The corner comes over and Ross Barkley wins a simple header before Andros Townsend (Luton) nods the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
25' Alfie Doughty (Luton) prepares to take a corner kick.
23' A pass by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
21' Ross Barkley (Luton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
20' The resulting corner from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) comes to nothing.

20' What a save from Thomas Kaminski! Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Newcastle are going to take it.
19' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
19' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Newcastle win a corner.
17' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
14' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
14' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
13' Newcastle are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Andros Townsend (Luton) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
11' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
10' Alfie Doughty (Luton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Luton will take a corner.
9' Jacob Brown (Luton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
8' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
7' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
4' Jacob Brown (Luton) wastes a huge chance as he sends a first-time shot from the goal area straight onto the left post!
3' Alfie Doughty (Luton) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
